Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

在交接件中加入「觀測範圍契約」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：把成功重組bytes、已知缺口bytes、連線狀態與監測區間分欄，對未觀察到的封包保留未知。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：把成功重組bytes、已知缺口bytes、連線狀態與監測區間分欄，對未觀察到的封包保留未知。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver sequence intervals, gap locations, content-visibility metrics and independent counts, explicitly separating byte and packet denominators.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Observation scope: Separate reassembled bytes, known gaps, connection state and observation interval, retaining unknowns for unobserved traffic.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Separate reassembled bytes, known gaps, connection state and observation interval, retaining unknowns for unobserved traffic. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。把成功重組bytes、已知缺口bytes、連線狀態與監測區間分欄，對未觀察到的封包保留未知。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Separate reassembled bytes, known gaps, connection state and observation interval, retaining unknowns for unobserved traffic.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Zeek的missed_bytes描述內容缺口，不能直接等同整個網路的封包遺失率；本課只分析有完整計數定義的TCP樣本。
knowledge.textEn: Zeek missed_bytes describes content gaps, not a universal packet-loss rate; analyze only TCP fixtures with explicitly defined byte accounting.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 把成功重組bytes、已知缺口bytes、連線狀態與監測區間分欄，對未觀察到的封包保留未知。
knowledge.textEn: Separate reassembled bytes, known gaps, connection state and observation interval, retaining unknowns for unobserved traffic.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學內容可觀測率=成功重組/(成功重組+已知缺口)；僅在兩者互斥且涵蓋同一內容區間時成立。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching content visibility is reassembled/(reassembled+known gaps), assuming disjoint accounting over the same content interval.

stages.title: 觀測範圍契約
stages.description: Zeek的missed_bytes描述內容缺口，不能直接等同整個網路的封包遺失率；本課只分析有完整計數定義的TCP樣本。 把成功重組bytes、已知缺口bytes、連線狀態與監測區間分欄，對未觀察到的封包保留未知。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 用互不重疊的TCP內容位元組範圍描述收到與缺口，保存connection_id、direction、start及end_exclusive。先合併重傳的相同範圍再計算長度，讓重傳不會提高9900的分子；本課分母是內容範圍，不是pcap封包數。
stages.descriptionEn: Zeek missed_bytes describes content gaps, not a universal packet-loss rate; analyze only TCP fixtures with explicitly defined byte accounting. Separate reassembled bytes, known gaps, connection state and observation interval, retaining unknowns for unobserved traffic. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Describe received and missing TCP content as disjoint byte intervals with connection_id, direction, start and end_exclusive. Union retransmitted ranges before calculating length so retransmission cannot inflate the 9,900-byte numerator. The denominator is the modeled content range, not the count of packets in a capture file or the number of generated log records.
